name: torbox-client
description: Use TorBox as a download client for Sonarr and Radarr. Emulates qBittorrent: your *arr apps send releases here, this container downloads them via TorBox and pulls the finished files to your downloads share so Sonarr/Radarr import them normally. Works like rdt-client but for TorBox.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: MUST be the same downloads share (at the same path) that Sonarr/Radarr use, so imports work.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port Sonarr/Radarr connect to (the emulated qBittorrent API).

variables.name: TORBOX_API_KEY
variables.description: Your TorBox API key from https://torbox.app/settings

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file ownership (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file ownership (Unraid default: 100 = users).

variables.name: SAVE_PATH
variables.description: Only set this if Sonarr/Radarr see the downloads at a DIFFERENT internal path than this container (e.g. /data/downloads). Otherwise leave blank.

variables.name: MAX_PARALLEL_DOWNLOADS
variables.description: Concurrent file downloads from the TorBox CDN.

variables.name: MAX_PARALLEL_TORRENTS
variables.description: Torrents pulled locally at the same time (0 = unlimited).

variables.name: MAX_DOWNLOAD_SPEED
variables.description: Aggregate download speed cap in MiB/s across all files (0 = unlimited).

variables.name: TORBOX_CLEANUP_HOURS
variables.description: Delete the TorBox cloud copy this long after the local download completes (0 = never). Frees your TorBox active-torrent slots; local files are kept.
